svg.text: ie-agent · what the model gets, stage by stage
one document · every request = system prompt + conversation so far + the tool schemas of the current stage · tools.py: stage(), offered_tools(), check_call()
every request to the model · agent.py _loop()
only the tools of the current stage
stages · stage(state) decides only the reading order
the TOC stays locked: map first
what the tools return · the tool result is the next message
Defaults: gnd_context on · toc on · examples optional · max_steps 14. map_to_gnd before the abstract keeps TITLE. An answer without a tool call is asked again, then finish is forced.
--examples-with-sections: the read tools bring their examples, no get_examples · --no-gnd-context: finish right after mapping · --no-toc: no read_toc
